verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI advertises querying/editing large codebases and debugging with natural language, and its 1M-token context is praised for absorbing entire codebases without manual file selection (comm-1, comm-12), but multiple hands-on reports describe poor codebase navigation, getting 'stuck in spaghetti code,' and even ignoring GEMINI.md context files (comm-13, comm-14, comm-15), directly contradicting the vendor's implicit claim of effortless whole-codebase understanding.
